chapter.verse: Eite' Honpa Pasian leh eite' lametna Khrisa Jesu ii thupiakna tawh Khris Jesu' sawltak khat ahi keimah Paul in,
upna sungah ka tapa taktak ahi Timothy kong hopih hi. Pa Pasian leh i Topa Khris Jesu' kiangpan hehpihna, thukhualna leh nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Macedonia gam ka manawh lai-in kong hanthot mah bangin Ephesus khua ah na omsuak inla, mi kimkhat' tungah genna hilhna na nei in. A maanlo thu a hilhloh nading uh ahi zongin,

khanglui tuanthute leh a bei theilo khanggui ciaptehnate a buaipih loh nading uh ahi zongin, tua mite na kho in. Tua bang thute in upna tawh a kingah Pasian' innsung vaihawmna thu sangin thulela upmawhsan satnate khangsakzaw hi.
Hih i kigen i kihilh thu ii a ngimna ahihleh ngaihsut siangtho, kitheihtawmna lungsim hoih leh upna taktak pana piangkhia itna thu ahi hi.
Hih thute pan mi kimkhat pialkhia uh a, khiatna neilo thukikup lamah kihei uh hi.
A thugente uh hitaleh, kimuangtak-a a pulak uh thute hitaleh, tel lo napi-un thukhun hilhcian syasuak nuam uh hi.
Tu-in thukhun cih pen mi khatpeuh in thulam tawnin a zat nakleh a hoih, cih i thei hi.

Hih thu, theitel i hih manin thukhun cih pen midikte' adinga kikhung hilo cih zong i thei hi. Thukhun cih pen thukhun a pampaihte leh thutangpekte, kihtakbei misiate leh mawhneite, a biaknavailo mite leh leitungzia a zuite, pianna nulehpa a thatte, tualthatte,
nulepa vai a takhialte, nulepa nam nih a mawhpihte, migu mizuakte, zuauphuakte, thumaanlo-a kiciamte, leh thuhilhna kilekkim tawh a kipelh peuhpeuh, hih bang mite' ading ahi hi.
Thuhilhna kilekkim cih ciangin kei' tunga hong ki-ap thu ahi, phat dinga kilawm Pasian ii a vanglian Lungdamna Thu tawh a kituak thu, cihna hi.
Kei hong thahatsak i Topa Khris Jesu, ama' hong hehpihna ka phat hi. A hang pen amah in kei a muanhuai-in hong ngaihsunin ama' seppina sungah hong guang hi.
Tua ma-in kei pen Pasian a gendai, thu-umte a bawlsia, awlmawh zahtak a neilo ka hi hi. Himah taleh thu-umlo ka hihna tawh theihloh huhau-a gamta ka hih manin kei hong kikhual hi.
I Topa' hehpihna pen Khris Jesu' sungah upna leh itna tawh hong kithuahin kei' ading kicing zihziah hi.
Mawhneite a honkhia dingin Khris Jesu leitung ah hong pai hi, cih thugenna pen a muantaak thu, a bupin a sanhuai thu hi a, mawhneite lakah kei a uangpen ka hi hi.

Tua hang mahin thukhualna a ngah ka hi a, tua pen Jesu Khris in amah upna tawh tawntung nuntakna a ngah ding mite' muhtheih lim ahi dingin a uangpen ahi keima' sungah ama' lungduaina cingtaak a lahkhiat theih nading ahi hi.
Khanghun khempeuh ii Kumpi, a sitheilo, muhtheihloh, khat bek ahi Pasian in a tawntung a tawntungin pahtawina leh minpha ngah ta hen. Amen.
Ka ta Timothy aw, nang tawh kisai tu ma-a om kamsannate tawh kizui-in na mai-ah hih kigen kihilhna kong phah hi. Hihte tawh thuhoih galdona ah mapang inla,
Upna leh kitheihtawmna lungsim a hoih lenkip in. Hih thu a nial manun mi kimkhat a upna uh tembaw sia tawh kibang khinta hi.
Tuate lakah Pasian gendai loh ding thu, sinin a theih nadingun Satan' khutsunga ka ap Hymenaeus leh Alexander zong kihel uh hi.
